description: Rerun of exp615 with current defaults to confirm baseline. Same exp365 architecture (tiny LUT-LM, ~43M, joint qkv + additive v, per-layer residual_lut), all TinyMultiHeadLut modules backward_mode='hybrid_smooth'. Current default flags: hybrid_smooth_n_alt=1, hybrid_smooth_autograd=False -> _TinyMHLutHybridSmooth manual path. Forward = 2-row smooth blend (main + Hamming-1 alt). Weight grad through 2 entries. Input/temperature grad through all K=64 entries via _soft_lut_bwd_body. exp615 result = 1.5845; if this rerun matches within ~0.002, the path is stable. Reference: exp365 (soft) = 1.6215, exp615 (hybrid_smooth original) = 1.5845, exp625 (n_alt=3 dense_input_grad) = 1.5742 (bs=16 SOTA), vanilla bs=16 exp328 = 1.3882.
